Place one plot on the current slide, fitted around the standard panel

Source: R/add-plot.R
hv_add_plot.Rd

Adds plot to the current slide of an officer presentation with its panel anchored to panel_box, so every plot slide of a slide format puts its panel in the same place. With fit = TRUE the plot's text sizes and text margins are reduced together by hv_fit_location() until axis text, axis titles, facet strips and plot titles lie on the slide and below its title.

Usage

hv_add_plot(
  doc,
  plot,
  panel_box = hv_panel_box(format = .hv_doc_format(doc)),
  fit = TRUE,
  png_fallback = TRUE,
  dpi = 300,
  ...
)

Arguments

doc

An rpptx object from officer::read_pptx() whose current slide receives the plot.

plot

A ggplot or patchwork object.

panel_box

Named list list(width, height, left, top), in inches. Defaults to hv_panel_box() for the slide format of doc, read from its slide size: 16:9 (every bundled template) or 4:3. A deck of any other size needs an explicit panel_box.

fit

TRUE (the default) to reduce the plot's text until the figure fits on the slide. FALSE places the plot at its own sizes and warns if it runs off the slide or into the title.

png_fallback

TRUE (the default) to place a PNG when the vector insert fails. FALSE lets the error through.

dpi

Resolution of the fallback PNG. Default 300.

...

Further arguments to hv_fit_location(): title_bottom, edge, min_scale, step, align, margin. The slide size is read from doc. align = "fill" widens the panel so the figure spans the slide, centered, instead of anchoring it to panel_box.

Value

doc, with the plot added, carrying an attribute "hv_fit": a list scale (the text scale used), fits (whether the figure lies inside the slide limits), png (whether the PNG fallback was used), location (the placement, in inches) and panel_box (the panel rectangle used). A message reports reduced text; a warning reports a figure that still does not fit.

Details

The plot goes in as an editable DrawingML vector graphic via rvg::dml(). A dense point cloud can overflow libxml2 and make that insert fail; with png_fallback = TRUE the plot is then rendered to a transparent PNG at exactly the fitted location's size and placed at the same location, so the panel still lands on panel_box.

Add the slide and its title first, with officer::add_slide() and officer::ph_with(); save_ppt() does all of this for a list of plots.

See also

save_ppt(), hv_fit_location(), hv_panel_box().

Examples

# \donttest{
p <- ggplot2::ggplot(mtcars, ggplot2::aes(hp, mpg)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point() +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Horsepower", y = "Miles per gallon") +
  theme_hv_ppt_dark()

template <- system.file("extdata", "hv_ppt_template.pptx",
                        package = "hvtiPlotR")
doc <- officer::read_pptx(template)
doc <- officer::add_slide(doc, layout = hv_ppt_layout("figure"))
doc <- officer::ph_with(doc, "Fuel economy",
                        location = officer::ph_location_type("title"))
doc <- hv_add_plot(doc, p)
attr(doc, "hv_fit")$scale
#> [1] 1
print(doc, target = file.path(tempdir(), "fitted.pptx"))
# }
